info.title: tobuilder API
info.description: Webhook delivery is at-least-once: the same event may arrive more than once. Consumers must deduplicate with the tobuilder-event-id header; the same value identifies the same event. Delivery retries use up to 5 exponential-backoff attempts; exhausted deliveries become dead and can only be revived with the resend route. Verify signatures with the tobuilder-signature header in the form t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex64>[,v1=<hex64>], signing the string `<timestamp>.<body>`, where `<timestamp>` is the `t=` value and `<body>` is the raw request body, with HMAC-SHA256 hex; timestamps must be within 300 seconds. After a secret rotation the previous secret remains valid for 24 hours, so during that window the tobuilder-signature header carries two v1= values, one per active secret, and a consumer must accept the delivery when either value matches.

endUserToken.name: x-end-user-token
endUserToken.description: The end user's token. Builders send the end user's Privy access token. The tobuilder-hosted Telegram bot sends a token issued by the tobuilder bot gateway instead. The server picks one verifier by the token's issuer and never retries a failed token with the other verifier. A gateway-issued token is accepted only with a builder API key of the subbuilder named in the token; otherwise the response is 403 with error.details.reason end_user_subbuilder_mismatch.

parameters.name: x-end-user-ip
parameters.description: Optional. The end user's IP address as observed by the calling builder's own gateway, forwarded on that end user's behalf. The value is a single IP address, never a list: X-Forwarded-For style chains are not part of this contract and are rejected as malformed. The header is optional and its absence is normal — no operation requires it, and no request is rejected or altered because it is missing. A malformed value (longer than 64 characters, or not a syntactically valid IPv4 or IPv6 address) is ignored: the request proceeds exactly as if the header were absent, and the server logs one warning carrying only a reason code (too_long or invalid_syntax) and the value's length — never the value itself, which is untrusted input. Normalization is the sender's responsibility: send IPv6 addresses in compressed lowercase standard form with any zone identifier removed. This server does not re-normalize — a valid but un-normalized value is accepted and kept byte for byte as received, so two spellings of one address stay two distinct values here. Only the syntax is validated; whether the value really is the end user's address rests on the assumption that the authenticated caller supplies it faithfully, which this server cannot check. The value is not currently used for geo-gating, rate limiting, or any other decision.

401.description: This endpoint requires two authentication credentials: Authorization: Bearer <builder API key> and x-end-user-token: <end-user token>. The end-user token is the end user's Privy access token or, for the tobuilder-hosted Telegram bot, a token issued by the tobuilder bot gateway. Both are required. End-user token validation failures include the failure reason in error.details.reason, and both token kinds use the same reasons. Builder API key authentication failures may omit error.details entirely. Possible reasons: end_user_token_missing means the x-end-user-token header is missing or empty and indicates a client bug; token_expired means the token has expired and the client should refresh the token and retry; token_audience_mismatch means the token audience does not match the audience this server expects, including a gateway-issued token with no audience, and the client must sign in again; token_invalid means the token is invalid for another reason and the client must sign in again; end_user_auth_unavailable means server-side end-user token verification is not configured, so retrying will not change the result and this is an operational issue.

403.description: The builder API key scope is insufficient (error.details.reason: api_key_scope_insufficient). /v1/users requires bot-link scope or higher. This response is also returned with error.details.reason end_user_subbuilder_mismatch when x-end-user-token is a valid token issued by the tobuilder bot gateway for a different subbuilder than the builder API key's; Privy access tokens never produce this reason, and retrying with the same credentials produces the same result. When telegramUserId is supplied with a Privy access token, telegram_account_not_linked means no Telegram account is linked to the Privy user, telegram_user_id_mismatch means it differs from the stored or newly verified Telegram user ID, and telegram_user_id_already_linked means the Telegram account linked to the Privy user is already linked to another user of this subbuilder (for example, one created with a gateway-issued token); users are never merged, so retrying produces the same result. When telegramUserId is supplied with a gateway-issued token, Privy is not consulted: telegram_user_id_mismatch means it differs from the Telegram user ID signed into the token, and the other two reasons do not occur. The user link is created before these checks, and a verified Telegram user ID may be saved before the mismatch response; retrying with a value different from the stored verified ID produces the same result.
